item.title: One Azure path
item.description:
These four Azure pieces are already in the app. This page is the order to wire them, using the sample collection as the thing the pipeline runs.

flowchart LR
 entra["Entra\nclient credentials"]:::step
 kv[("Key Vault\nakv://")]:::secret
 api["Users API\nor an MCP server"]:::out
 aoai["Azure OpenAI\non the tab"]:::store
 ado(["Azure DevOps\nPro termorq-cli run"]):::exit

 entra --> api
 kv --> api
 api --> aoai
 api --> ado

 classDef store fill:#134e4a,stroke:#5eead4,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef secret fill:#FFC131,stroke:#b45309,stroke-width:2px,color:#1a1404
 classDef step fill:#0f766e,stroke:#99f6e4,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef out fill:#155e75,stroke:#67e8f9,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef exit fill:#166534,stroke:#86efac,stroke-width:2px,color:#f0fdf4
 linkStyle 0,2 stroke:#5eead4,stroke-width:2.5px
 linkStyle 1 stroke:#FFC131,stroke-width:2.5px
 linkStyle 3 stroke:#86efac,stroke-width:2.5px
